quotas.description: The maximum number of BatchGetImage requests that you can make per second in the current Region. When an image is pulled, the BatchGetImage API is called once to retrieve the image manifest. If you request a quota increase for this API, review your GetDownloadUrlForLayer usage as well.

quotas.name: Rate of CompleteLayerUpload requests
quotas.description: The maximum number of CompleteLayerUpload requests that you can make per second in the current Region. When an image is pushed, the CompleteLayerUpload API is called once per each new image layer to verify that the upload has completed.

quotas.name: Rate of GetAuthorizationToken requests

quotas.name: Rate of InitiateLayerUpload requests
quotas.description: The maximum number of InitiateLayerUpload requests that you can make per second in the current Region. When an image is pushed, the InitiateLayerUpload API is called once per image layer that has not already been uploaded. Whether or not an image layer has been uploaded is determined by the BatchCheckLayerAvailability API action.

quotas.name: Rate of UploadLayerPart requests
quotas.description: The maximum number of UploadLayerPart requests that you can make per second in the current Region. When an image is pushed, each new image layer is uploaded in parts and the UploadLayerPart API is called once per each new image layer part.

quotas.name: Rate of GetDownloadUrlForLayer requests
quotas.description: The maximum number of GetDownloadUrlForLayer requests that you can make per second in the current Region. When an image is pulled, the GetDownloadUrlForLayer API is called once per image layer that is not already cached. If you request a quota increase for this API, review your BatchGetImage usage as well.

quotas.name: Rate of PutImage requests
quotas.description: The maximum number of PutImage requests that you can make per second in the current Region. When an image is pushed and all new image layers have been uploaded, the PutImage API is called once to create or update the image manifest and the tags associated with the image.

quotas.name: Rate of BatchCheckLayerAvailability requests
quotas.description: The maximum number of BatchCheckLayerAvailability requests that you can make per second in the current Region. When an image is pushed to a repository, each image layer is checked to verify if it has been uploaded before. If it has been uploaded, then the image layer is skipped.

quotas.name: ListScheduleGroups request rate
quotas.description: Maximum ListScheduleGroups requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval.

quotas.name: ListTagsForResource request rate
quotas.description: Lists the tags associated with the Scheduler resource.

quotas.name: CreateScheduleGroup request rate
quotas.description: Maximum CreateScheduleGroup requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval.

quotas.name: UntagResource request rate
quotas.description: Removes one or more tags from the specified Scheduler resource.

quotas.name: DeleteScheduleGroup request rate
quotas.description: Maximum DeleteScheduleGroup requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval.

quotas.name: DeleteSchedule request rate
quotas.description: Maximum DeleteSchedule requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval. This is adjustable to tens of thousands of requests per second.

quotas.name: ListSchedules request rate
quotas.description: Maximum ListSchedules requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval.

quotas.name: CreateSchedule request rate
quotas.description: Maximum CreateSchedule requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval. This is adjustable to tens of thousands of requests per second.

quotas.name: GetScheduleGroup request rate
quotas.description: Maximum GetScheduleGroup requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval.

quotas.name: Number of schedule groups
quotas.description: Maximum number of schedule groups per region.

quotas.name: UpdateSchedule request rate
quotas.description: Maximum UpdateSchedule requests per second. When you reach this quota, EventBridge Scheduler rejects requests for this operation for the remainder of the interval. This is adjustable to tens of thousands of requests per second.

quotas.name: TagResource request rate
quotas.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified Scheduler resource.

quotas.name: Number of schedules
quotas.description: The maximum number of schedules per region. This quota includes one-time schedules that have completed running. We recommend configuring your schedules to automatically delete after completion using the ActionAfterCompletion feature. This is adjustable to billions of schedules.

quotas.name: Invocations throttle limit in transactions per second
